messages:
Morgan A.: Morning team — async standup.
Morgan A.: What I did: moved MacroHealth contract to legal, demoed NovaGrid pilot.
Morgan A.: Blockers: MacroHealth asking about HSM/KMS for on-prem private deployment, wants list of supported KMS vendors + expected timeline.
Morgan A.: Today: gather security answers, ping infra for ETA, prep canary plan.
Sam K.: Re: HSM — we have a short doc, will attach link. We support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, HashiCorp Vault; HSM via partner integration needs SOW. :thinking:
Sam K.: quick snippet of prod config we've used:
Sam K.: ```yaml
key_provider: vault
migration: manual
``` 
Ritika P.: I'll pull the compliance checklist and add HSM rows. ETA EOD. @Daniel (Sec) can you confirm acceptable fallback (KMS-only) for pilot?
Daniel (Sec): Fallback to KMS-only is OK for non-PHI pilot, must be documented. For customer wanting HSM we need support contract and SOC2 addendum. I'll DM customer template. :+1:
Elena R.: For NovaGrid POC, engineering wants the test dataset and a short access window. Morgan, can you share who owns that on their side?
Morgan A.: Contact is Priya (prod lead) — I'll intro after I get the security blurb. Also flagging legal for the SOW path.
deploy-bot: New build 2026.03.17-rc deployed to staging for NovaGrid POC. :rocket:
Morgan A.: thanks — small ask: can someone ping eng to prioritize the telemetry webhook for the POC? should be a 2-day task.
Sam K.: I'll raise the CR and tag eng-platform. Ping @eng-platform when done. :eyes:
Ritika P.: noted. I'll update the pipeline spreadsheet with security status + next action.
Morgan A.: Great, thanks all. If no objections I'll send intro + security answers by noon Pacific.
